source_topic: Maextro V800 brake-pedal bracket failure in Dongchedi tests
authorization: Requested research and X post; final content review required by AGENTS.md
final_text:
Brake safety is the baseline for any carmaker.

Dongchedi reported broken brake-pedal brackets on all three Maextro V800s it tested during repeated emergency stops from 100 km/h. Maextro calls the conditions non-standard and extreme, says no such failures have occurred in customer use, and has promised design improvements and free upgrades.

Mistakes can happen as an industry develops. But safety is non-negotiable. Owners deserve a transparent investigation, independent retesting and a clear fix.

https://carnewschina.com/2026/10/09/huawei-jacs-maextro-responds-to-brake-pedal-failure-of-its-150k-usd-car/
